# qbittorrent_credentials (Resource)

Singleton write-only management of qBittorrent SMTP, proxy and DynDNS passwords. Import ID: application. Configure a password and its version together; increment only the relevant version to rotate a password. An empty password explicitly clears it when the native setter supports clearing. Removing both fields relinquishes management without changing the stored password. Read and destroy never retrieve or mutate passwords.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `dyndns_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Dynamic DNS password (write-only). Set together with dyndns_password_wo_version; empty string clears it.
- `dyndns_password_wo_version` (Number) Increment this counter when rotating the corresponding write-only password. The password is sent only when this version changes.
- `proxy_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Proxy password (write-only). Set together with proxy_password_wo_version; empty string clears it.
- `proxy_password_wo_version` (Number) Increment this counter when rotating the corresponding write-only password. The password is sent only when this version changes.
- `smtp_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMTP password (write-only). Set together with smtp_password_wo_version; empty string clears it.
- `smtp_password_wo_version` (Number) Increment this counter when rotating the corresponding write-only password. The password is sent only when this version changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton ID: application.
